decision.title: Demand-control sizes for searchBooks and Order.items
decision.question: D-zkxfd4 chose to add @listSize. lumen_books_books and lumen_books_orders now carry @listSize(slicingArguments: ["limit"], sizedFields: ["data"], requireOneSlicingArgument: false) from the documented limit (default 10, maximum 50). lumen_books_searchBooks takes no size argument and Order.items has no documented maximum, so the source gives no number for either (federation-subgraph.md: ask the user, never guess). What assumedSize should each carry?

choices.label: I will give the numbers (searchBooks page size and the largest Order.items count)
Leave both without @listSize (the router uses its default estimate)
